concerns.text: The PGLS model specification incorrectly includes `phylo_cov` as a fixed‑effect predictor (e.g., `lifespan ~ telomere_length + body_mass + phylo_cov`). In phylogenetic generalized least squares the phylogenetic covariance is incorporated via the error structure (λ or the variance‑covariance matrix), not as a separate covariate column. Treating it as a predictor mis‑specifies the model and can lead to biased coefficient estimates, violating the statistical assumptions of PGLS.
